findings.highlight: The sun is starting to rise by the time I arrive at the forest entrance.
findings.evidenceJa: とっくに夜は明けていた。
findings.governingReading: とっくに夜は明けていた after taxi delays is completed earlier dawn.
findings.explanation: Dawn already long broken becomes sun starting to rise.

findings.highlight: to say nothing of the castle
findings.evidenceJa: 城門にさえ見張りがいない
findings.governingReading: 10城門 is gate while11城の玄関 is building entrance he avoids via second-floor window.
findings.explanation: Castle gate and building entrance lose distinction.

findings.highlight: It's already been a full day since Sakura took Illya away.
findings.evidenceJa: もうじき一日が経過する。
findings.governingReading: もうじき一日が経過する marks approaching one day.
findings.explanation: Nearly a day becomes already full day.

findings.evidenceJa: もう一人の子にセラと呼ばれていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers Illya’s caretaker as the woman another girl called Sella.
findings.explanation: The Japanese attributes the remembered name to another girl. The English instead calls Sella the “other caretaker” and makes Illya the apparent speaker.

findings.evidenceJa: お帰りくださいエミヤ様。
findings.governingReading: お帰りください politely commands departure, consistent refusal audience and leave-or-die24.
findings.explanation: Please go home becomes welcome home.

findings.governingReading: 淡々と語る depicts flat delivery of refusal after asking any further matter; he is silent.
findings.explanation: Even speech becomes cutting him off.

findings.evidenceJa: そうだろ、ならイリヤの居場所を、
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s affirmative interrupted request is dialogue before Sella reply.

findings.highlight: as soon as I reach for the window, a blade slides into my neck.
findings.evidenceJa: 窓に手をかけたまま、首筋に刃が走った。
findings.governingReading: 窓に手をかけたまま fixes achieved contact maintained when neck cut.
findings.explanation: Hand already on window during slash becomes slash while reaching for it.
